meta.title: Bulk PO Creation / Upload: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify whether Bulk PO Creation / Upload is absent or refused.
Repeat Bulk PO Creation / Upload as a Buyer and verify it is available.
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.
Inspect or record the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify whether Bulk PO Creation / Upload is absent or refused.; Repeat Bulk PO Creation / Upload as a Buyer and verify it is available.; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.; Inspect or record the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then as a Buyer on the Enterprise tenant, attempt Bulk PO Creation / Upload with the bulk upload template for each role, and record whether the action is absent, refused, or available

steps.note: No catalog step can access role-specific sessions or the Bulk PO Creation / Upload flow.
Provides a final known-screen assertion after the tester handoff, but does not test the bulk PO permission behavior.
